newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson sees Brazilian market growing fast in '97.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson sees Brazilian market growing fast in '97.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Friday Brazil was one of its fastest growing markets and that it could become the company's third largest market this year.
"Brazil could advance to become fourth or third this year," chief executive Lars Ramqvist told the annual general meeting.
Brazil is presently Ericsson's seventh largest market and accounts for four percent of the company's sales.
The U.S. is Ericsson's largest market with 12 percent of sales, followed by China/Hong Kong with 10 percent and Britain with seven percent.
Ericsson earlier released first quarter earnings showing pre-tax profit rose 30 percent to 2.02 billion crowns while net sales rose to 30.71 billion crowns from 22.66 billion.
